title: Lima component schema
description: The format of a Lima component schema file: the public API of one React component, as data. Format version 1.0.0.

$schema.description: Path or identifier of this format.

id.description: Stable identifier, snake_case. Equals the file name without extension.

importPath.description: The module the component is imported from. The entry point reflects lifecycle: experimental APIs and deprecated components have their own.

description.description: What the component is for, in one or two sentences.

passthroughElement.description: The HTML element whose attributes the component also accepts.

subcomponents.description: Parts rendered inside the component, such as Dialog.Header.

name.description: Dotted name, starting with the parent component's name.

types.description: Named object types that appear in prop types. Not renderable.

type.description: The TypeScript type of the prop, on one line.

defaultValue.description: The default, written as it would appear in code.

deprecated.description: True when the prop still works but must not be used in new code.
